_comment: Tier-2: KM.VtkOutput rejects the sliding-cable/ring generic Line3DN geometry, and the documented workaround (a visualisation SubModelPart of plain Element3D2N segments) is accepted. Pitfall (kratos.cable_net #1). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). A ModelPart holding SlidingCableElement3D3N makes VtkOutput(...).PrintOutput() raise RuntimeError 'Error: Modelpart contains elements or conditions with geometries for which no VTK-output is implemented!', while the same call on a part holding Element3D2N returns cleanly. Both halves are asserted so the fixture also proves the workaround. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
